details: Determining whether two questions ask the same thing, e.g. Quora duplicate detection. It is a paraphrase-style task used for FAQ consolidation and search dedup.

explainer.lead: Deciding whether two questions ask the same thing is essential for deduplicating FAQs and search results. It is a paraphrase-style matching task.

tiers.eli5: It’s like recognizing that “How do I reset my password?” and “What’s the way to change my password?” mean the same thing.
tiers.practitioner: Engineers use it for FAQ consolidation and search deduplication; a pitfall is matching questions that share words but differ in intent, such as “cancel” versus “confirm.”
tiers.paperLevel: Determining whether two questions ask the same thing, e.g. Quora duplicate detection; a paraphrase-style task used for FAQ consolidation and search dedup.

explainer.example: “How can I learn Spanish?” and “What’s the best way to study Spanish?” are classified as similar.
